name: Infoblox — Threat Protect DROP
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "Threat"
| filter infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log contains "threat-protect-log"
| alter src_ip = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "src=(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
        category = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "cat=\"([^\"]+)\""), 0),
        qname = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "qname=(\S+)"), 0)
| filter src_ip != null
| bin _time span = 10m
| comp count() as alerts,
       count_distinct(category) as distinct_categories,
       values(category) as categories,
       values(qname) as blocked_domains
       by src_ip, _time
| filter alerts >= 30 and distinct_categories >= 3
| fields src_ip, categories, blocked_domains
description: Threat-Protect drops for one client — BloxOne C&C / malware category detection.
